a394e1a3fffafce0.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Supervisor Loss Prevention to join their team in Mecca, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing security operations and ensuring the safety and protection of guests, employees, and hotel assets. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience, including at least one year in a supervisory capacity. Key Responsibilities Perform regular rounds throughout the hotel, secure rooms, and assist guests with room access. Conduct emergency drills, daily security inspections, and physical hazard searches. Lead investigations, interrogations, and key control audits. Monitor video surveillance equipment and alarm systems, and manage access to secure areas. Respond to accidents, provide first aid/CPR as needed, and contact emergency services. Gather information, complete detailed reports, and maintain confidentiality of all documents. De-escalate tensions, resolve dangerous situations, and escort undesirable persons off property. Ensure compliance with alcohol control legislation and company security policies and procedures. Assist management in training, motivating, and coaching employees, serving as a role model for fair treatment policies. Report maintenance issues, accident hazards, accidents, or injuries, and complete required safety training. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent. At least 2 years of related work experience in loss prevention or security. At least 1 year of supervisory experience. Physical Requirements and Work Environment Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds (* kg) independently, and assist with objects over 75 pounds (34 kg). Capable of standing, sitting, or walking for extended periods or an entire shift, and moving quickly as required by work situations. Proficiency in reading, visually verifying information, and inspecting equipment. Ability to use computers and point-of-sale systems for information entry and retrieval. Requires fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination for grasping and manipulating objects. Ability to reach overhead, below the knees, bend, twist, pull, stoop, and navigate various spaces and surfaces. Communication and Professionalism Greet and acknowledge guests according to company standards, using clear, appropriate, and professional language. Answer telephones with appropriate etiquette and respond effectively to guest and employee concerns. Maintain a clean and professional uniform and appearance. Uphold confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Support colleagues with dignity and respect, contributing to team goals. Application Information This full-time position offers a competitive salary, which will be disclosed during the hiring process. Candidates meeting the qualifications are encouraged to apply.

a314c5713661d588.description: About the Role Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Cook III to join their team in Mecca, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves contributing to the culinary operations by preparing high-quality dishes and ensuring an excellent dining experience for guests. The role requires a focus on culinary standards and attention to detail in food preparation. Role Impact As a Cook III, you will play a key role in maintaining high culinary standards, which directly influences guest satisfaction. Working within a dedicated team, you will contribute to preparing seasonal menus and unique presentations. Your efforts in carefully preparing each dish are essential to encouraging guests to dine with us and return. Key Responsibilities Prepare fresh ingredients and cook according to recipes or menus. Cook food and prepare high-quality dishes within prescribed timelines. Test dishes to verify preparation and temperature. Safely and responsibly use kitchen equipment. Ensure hygiene and cleanliness of surfaces and storage containers. Qualifications and Requirements Excellent teamwork skills and strong attention to detail. Positive attitude and an outgoing personality. Ability to lift and move items weighing up to 25 lbs (11 kg). Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Maintain a neat, professional appearance in a clean uniform. Completion of safety training and certification is required before starting the position. Recommended Qualifications Education Level: High school diploma or equivalent. Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience. Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience required. Licenses or Certifications: None specified. Work Environment This role is based in a professional kitchen environment, requiring collaboration within a team of culinary experts. It is a full-time position that offers opportunities for continuous learning and skill development in a dynamic setting.

a3204b3e6a40eb18.description: About the Role National Medical Care is seeking an HR Officer, HR Operations, to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is responsible for supporting daily HR operations across the facility, encompassing HR administration, employee records management, and payroll coordination. The role ensures the efficient execution of HR processes in alignment with company policies, labor laws, and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Manage HR operations, including employee records, contracts, and HR documentation. Ensure consistent implementation of HR policies and procedures across the facility. Maintain accurate HR databases and prepare reports for leadership as required. Support HR processes in alignment with CBAHI and JCI standards. Coordinate with the Payroll Officer to ensure timely and accurate salary processing. Serve as a liaison between employees, HR, and Payroll for payroll-related queries. Assist in resolving payroll discrepancies in collaboration with the Payroll Officer and finance team. Ensure compliance with Saudi labor law, GOSI regulations, HRSD guidelines, and other statutory requirements. Prepare and maintain documentation required for government inspections and audits. Support reporting related to Saudization (Nitaqat) and other labor regulations. Assist the Head of HR in maintaining HR documentation and records in line with CBAHI and JCI standards. Support HR audits and inspections as required. Support HR reporting, metrics, and dashboards for the Head of HR. Coordinate with HR team members to ensure smooth execution of HR processes. Address employee HR queries and escalate complex issues to the Head of HR. Identify opportunities to improve HR processes at the facility. Ensure HR operations comply with CMC policies, labor laws, accreditation standards, and internal controls. Assist in preparing HR-related documentation for audits or inspections. Coordinate with the Quality Improvement department to implement HR-related QI activities. Monitor and report on HR processes to support continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure HR activities align with overall quality standards and company objectives. Perform additional tasks and duties as assigned by superiors and be flexible to work in all CMC Business Units. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in HR operations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, contributing to the HR department of National Medical Care.

a34e6d30f7ce6e2e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أسرع مشوار للخدمات اللوجستية عن سائق سيارة خاص للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على قيادة السيارة لتوصيل الطلبات والطرود بكفاءة وأمان، مع الالتزام التام بقواعد المرور ومعايير السلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة السيارة لتوصيل الطلبات والطرود، مع ضمان الالتزام بالمواعيد المحددة للتبليغ عن أي تأخير اضطراري. الالتزام الصارم بقواعد المرور والأمن والسلامة، وتجنب ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية على السيارة لمعالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تظهر. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة التي تتطلب فحص الخبراء عند ملاحظة أي خلل أثناء القيادة. الالتزام التام بجميع أدلة الإجراءات والمواصفات والمعايير، بالإضافة إلى سياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال القيادة. القدرة على الالتزام بالجداول الزمنية المحددة لتوصيل الطلبات. معرفة جيدة بقواعد المرور وأنظمة السلامة. القدرة على إجراء فحوصات أساسية للسيارة وتحديد الأعطال البسيطة. بيئة العمل يعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بمعايير الشركة في تقديم الخدمات اللوجستية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المنطقة: مكة المكرمة. المدينة: جدة. الراتب: غير معلن.

a3bfaff06ac4fbdc.description: About the Role Johnson Controls Arabia is seeking a Receiver to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time position involves providing timely and effective clerical support to the transportation department by following established procedures and guidelines. a36decd04ee64f8d.description: About Evostel (previously AQESA) Evostel, formerly known as AQESA, is seeking a Human Resources Officer to join its team in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The HR Officer is responsible for supporting and executing daily Human Resources operations and administrative activities. This role ensures the effective implementation of HR policies and procedures, maintains accurate employee records, and provides HR services throughout the employee lifecycle. The HR Officer contributes to compliance with applicable labor laws, regulations, and organizational requirements, supporting the smooth and efficient delivery of HR functions. Key Responsibilities Recommend improvements to departmental policies and direct the implementation of procedures and controls for HR activities. Execute the onboarding process and conduct new joiner orientations. Follow up on and process employee probation appraisals. Process employee leave requests and update their information. Manage employee additions and removals in the Qiwa system. Register work-related injuries in GOSI. Issue medical insurance and open claim requests with the medical insurance company. Support payroll processes as needed. Process employee loans and advances requests. Issue employee letters and salary certificates. Calculate and settle End of Service Benefits (ESB). Process employee attendance and overtime. Support and cooperate in administration activities, including arranging and managing employee travel bookings. Ensure completion of all employee offboarding activities. Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives. Support the implementation and follow-up of performance management activities. Ensure compliance with Saudization regulations, Nitaqat requirements, and profession-specific localization requirements. HR Database Management Update all employee data in the Human Capital Management (HCM) system. Archive all employee documents in their personal/digital files, ensuring proper and safe maintenance. Electronically archive employee information and documents. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in Human Resources operations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Eastern Region.

a3922532700e6ff3.description: The Executive Director, Utilities leads the City Operations utilities mandate across Qiddiya City, covering power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, ICT, water bodies, lagoons and other utility systems within scope. The role is accountable for improving the operational management and resilience of existing interim networks, water bodies and lagoons; protecting continuity of service during construction; defining the city-wide utilities strategy, ownership model and operating standards; and ensuring permanent utility and water assets are planned, designed, delivered and accepted in line with City Operations and Qiddiya City Authority requirements. Reporting to the City Chief Operations Officer, the role coordinates closely with planning, design, delivery, district and asset teams, QTech, Smart City, utility providers, regulators and O&M partners to manage material service, capacity, water-quality, commercial and reputational risks. Utilities Strategy and Asset Ownership Develop and implement the City Operations strategy for all utilities, water bodies and lagoons, including service outcomes, water quality, resilience, governance, ownership, operating and cost model, standards and long-term investment priorities. Determine which interim and permanent utility assets will be adopted by City Operations and which will be owned or operated by utilities, districts, assets or other third parties, with clear decision rights and accountability. Improve the operational management, asset information, condition oversight and service performance of existing interim power, potable water, renewed water and ICT networks. Develop and implement a protection and continuity strategy for live interim utility networks during construction, recognising that outages create a material operational and reputational risk for Qiddiya. Maintain an accurate city-wide utilities asset register and GIS record, including surveys of existing interim networks and requirements for any relocation arising from development works. Advise the City Chief Operations Officer and governance on utility priorities, delivery dependencies, capacity constraints, temporary solutions, investment needs and material operational risks. Planning, Design and Operational Assurance Coordinate with planning, design and delivery teams to accelerate permanent utility assets needed for growing city-wide operational, development and major-event requirements. Define City Operations requirements and assure their incorporation into utility strategies, project briefs, designs, specifications, delivery plans and permanent-asset operating models. Verify that interim and full-build infrastructure can meet peak utility loads, including concurrent major-event scenarios and increased city footfall, with adequate redundancy and recovery arrangements. Lead operational assurance of critical dependencies and interfaces, including permanent and temporary power, potable and renewed water capacity, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, utility corridors, ICT connectivity and data-centre requirements. Coordinate space planning for utility operational centres, O&M yards, workshops and equipment and spare-parts storage, confirming the required number, location and functionality across Qiddiya City. Participate in multidisciplinary stage-gate reviews and challenge solutions to optimise safety, service continuity, maintainability, whole-life cost, efficiency and operational readiness. Readiness, Handover and Asset Acceptance Establish utility readiness, testing, commissioning, handover and operational acceptance requirements, including permits, asset data, GIS records, operating procedures, warranties, spares, training and defect closure. Assess acceptance evidence and recommend City Operations acceptance only where ownership, operating responsibility, funding and service interfaces are clear. Aggregate city-wide O&M requirements and lead the technical and operational strategy for a multi-year city-wide utilities O&M services procurement, coordinating with Commercial, Procurement, Finance and Legal. Coordinate mobilisation and transition arrangements for interim and permanent networks, including temporary service extensions where delays to permanent assets require continued use of temporary power, water or ICT solutions. Ensure adopted assets are captured in the asset management system and GIS with complete, accurate and usable information for safe operation and maintenance. Performance, Risk and Lifecycle Management Establish KPIs and executive reporting for availability, outages, reliability, water quality, water-body and lagoon condition, capacity, losses, consumption, compliance, incidents, cost, complaints and recovery performance. Maintain a consolidated utilities risk and dependency register covering delivery slippage, temporary-network fragility, corridor and land constraints, capacity shortfalls, construction interfaces and unbudgeted temporary solutions. Develop lifecycle, renewal and investment plans based on criticality, condition, service demand, resilience, regulatory requirements and whole-life value. Confirm the operational data required for smart utilities, align the Siemens utilities integration study with QTech and Smart City initiatives, and define requirements for monitoring, analytics and future digital-twin capability. Ensure emergency, outage, business continuity and recovery plans are coordinated with City Operations, districts, assets, utility providers, safety, security and event functions. Commercial, Regulatory and Stakeholder Management Define the utilities cost-recovery model, including cost allocation, metering, tariffs or charges, billing inputs, subsidy requirements, subsidy period and governance for costs levied on operational assets. Lead the utility component of the city service charge in collaboration with the Executive Director, City Asset Management and Finance and Control, ensuring transparent and auditable recovery mechanisms. Draft and implement service level agreements between City Operations and districts or assets for utilities adopted by City Operations, including service standards, responsibilities, escalation, outage communication and performance reporting. Develop City Operations codes, standards and guidelines for construction in the vicinity of live utility assets, including permits, protection measures, access controls and incident response. Manage strategic interfaces with authorities, regulators, Saudi Electricity, water entities, telecoms providers, developers, districts, operators and specialist O&M service providers. Ensure statutory, technical, environmental, commercial and contractual obligations are identified, governed and evidenced across all adopted utilities. Leadership and Capability Building Build and lead a capable municipal utilities team with clear accountability, effective governance and disciplined delivery. Develop Saudi talent through structured recruitment, mentoring, role exposure, succession planning and knowledge transfer from advisers, delivery partners and operators. Promote collaboration, technical rigour, commercial discipline, innovation and continuous improvement. Education and Professional Qualifications Bachelor's degree in engineering, utilities, infrastructure, asset management or a related discipline. Postgraduate qualification in engineering, asset management, business or a related field is advantageous. Relevant professional registration or accreditation in engineering, utilities, asset management or project management is preferred. Experience Substantial executive leadership experience in city-wide utilities, infrastructure asset management or utility network development within a complex city, municipality, mixed-use destination or major development programme. a3457a12e5a4342a.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo is a global leader in beverages and convenient foods, with products enjoyed by consumers worldwide. In 2021, the company generated over $79 billion in net revenue through a portfolio that includes brands such as LAY’S®, DORITOS®, CHEETOS®, GATORADE®, PEPSI®, and QUAKER®. PepsiCo operates with a vision to achieve growth through PepsiCo Positive (pep+), a strategic transformation focused on sustainability and human capital. The company fosters a dynamic and collaborative culture, committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. PepsiCo aims to create an environment where all associates can thrive and contribute to the company's success. The Role of Key Account Executive PepsiCo is seeking a Key Account Executive for a full-time position in Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This role is an integral part of the KSA sales team, primarily focused on maximizing sales volume, achieving distribution targets, and ensuring high levels of customer service. The Key Account Executive will also be responsible for minimizing stales, implementing merchandising standards, and collecting accounts receivable. Key Responsibilities Operate with integrity and respect, adhering to all PepsiCo and SSFL values, procedures, and policies. Manage the stales budget, maintaining it at * of store sales. Utilize the Stock & Order tool for purchase orders to prevent overstocking. Conduct store visits according to the agreed journey plan to process purchase orders. Manage short-dated stock based on monthly freshness reports. Perform monthly reconciliations with stores and ensure timely collection of dues. Cultivate strong relationships with Section Managers and Store Managers. Achieve monthly store targets as per weekly phasing. Identify and develop opportunities to enhance customer business. Confirm Statements of Accounts with customers on a quarterly basis. Report on competitive activities, initiatives, and new products. Ensure timely implementation of all weekly activities and CDA & rented visibilities within stores. Provide agreed updates punctually. Manage merchandisers through daily meetings, coaching, and supervision, including auditing their store visits and execution. Ensure excellent SSFL execution in stores, outperforming competitors. Maintain a professional appearance to reflect the SSFL image. Performance Measures Sales Target and SSFL market shares within customer stores. Industry expertise. Execution excellence. CDA implementation. Weekly activity implementation and updates. Monthly reconciliations and collections. Training and Development The Key Account Executive will participate in training courses designed to enhance professionalism and customer service skills. Daily debriefings with pre-sellers and merchandisers are also required to ensure coordinated efforts and continuous improvement.

a3777e73748c48cd.description: About the Role Almarai is seeking a Senior Team Manager – Engineering to oversee engineering maintenance and utilities operations at its Seafood Processing Plant. This full-time position is based in the Makkah region, specifically covering King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, and Rabigh. The role focuses on ensuring the reliability, efficiency, and continuous operation of industrial HVAC, refrigeration, plant utilities, and processing equipment, while upholding high standards of safety, quality, and operational performance. Key Responsibilities Lead and supervise a multi-skilled engineering and maintenance team. Oversee the operation and maintenance of industrial HVAC, refrigeration, and cooling systems. Ensure optimal performance of chillers, air handling units, compressors, and associated utilities. Plan and execute preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities. Troubleshoot equipment failures, conduct root cause analysis, and minimize downtime. Monitor equipment performance, maintenance KPIs, and operational efficiency. Ensure compliance with HSE standards, quality requirements, and maintenance procedures. Manage maintenance budgets, spare parts, and contractor activities. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance equipment reliability and reduce maintenance costs. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in engineering and maintenance. Demonstrated experience in leading engineering and maintenance teams. Proficiency in managing industrial HVAC, refrigeration, and plant utility systems. About Almarai Almarai is the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy and the region’s largest food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company. Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Almarai Company is recognized as the #1 FMCG Brand in the MENA region and holds a market leadership position across all its categories in the GCC. Almarai employs over 46,000 professionals across the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. In 2025, the company reported a net income of SAR billion on sales of SAR 22 billion. Almarai is engaged in an expansion program and strategic acquisitions in new vertical markets.

a31c33f8c5b88be1.description: About the Opportunity Cornerstone Global Partners (CGP Group) is seeking a Design Manager to join a residential-led real estate developer in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is client-side and involves managing design delivery from the initial brief through to construction, as the business enters a significant delivery phase with a large residential pipeline. The position is suited for an individual who aims to contribute to building the business rather than simply joining an established process. Key Responsibilities Manage design across residential projects, from concept development to construction handover. Coordinate external design consultants (architectural, structural, MEP, landscape, and others) to ensure adherence to programme and quality standards. Develop and control design briefs, ensuring designs meet commercial and delivery objectives. Lead design reviews, manage design changes, and drive value engineering initiatives. Collaborate with commercial, project, and construction teams to prevent design-related delays in delivery. Track design progress and risks against a fast-track programme, escalating issues promptly. Contribute to establishing design management processes and standards as the business expands. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience (5-10 years) as a Design Manager or in a similar role on residential projects, preferably medium- or high-rise, multi-unit developments. A strong delivery focus, with experience guiding design through to construction rather than solely coordination. Client-side or developer experience is preferred. Experience managing multiple design consultants and, ideally, leading a team. Strong knowledge of KSA design approvals and regulations. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to drive results. A hands-on, adaptable approach, comfortable operating within a fast-moving, growing business environment. Candidates must be based in Riyadh or willing to relocate. Application Process This role may utilize Keystone AI’s artificial intelligence or automated tools for application review and screening. These tools support human judgment in hiring decisions. To complete your application, you must register on the Keystone AI platform, create your profile, upload your CV, and submit your application. An optional AI interview is encouraged but not required for consideration. By submitting your personal data and/or resume, you consent to its collection, use, and disclosure by the company (or its agent) for processing and administration related to this job application. CGP Group is an affirmative equal-opportunity employer and recruitment firm.

a3078cd796e2e576.description: موظف/ـة تسويق عن بُعد — ساكن القصيم أبحث عن شخص واحد من منطقة القصيم يشتغل معي عن بعد بدوام جزئي على متجر إلكتروني لمنتجات السفر (منصة سلة). المهام: ١. إدارة الحملات الإعلانية على سناب شات وتيك توك داخل السعودية: إعداد، متابعة، تحسين. ٢. المحتوى: كتابة وتصميم مواد الإعلان ومحتوى الحسابات. ٣. إدارة متجر سلة: إضافة المنتجات وتحديثها، العروض، ومتابعة الطلبات. المطلوب من المتقدم: - سابق أعمال تثبت خبرته: روابط حسابات أو حملات أو متاجر اشتغل عليها. - خبرة عملية في إعلانات سناب شات وتيك توك ومنصة سلة. - يذكر في رده: أجره الشهري المتوقع، وساعات تفرغه الأسبوعية.

a303d50a42876cab.description: About the Role Alfanar Projects is seeking a Contracts Engineer for infrastructure projects. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The Contracts Engineer will administer the main contract for infrastructure projects delivered to Saudi Entertainment Ventures (SEVEN), ensuring all contractual obligations are met and commercial matters are resolved through to closeout. Key Responsibilities Review executed contracts, scope of work, drawings, specifications, bill of quantities, and amendments to identify gaps, exclusions, interface obligations, and commercial risks, escalating issues with proposed actions. Maintain registers for contractual obligations, correspondence, notices, variations, and claims, tracking deadlines, approvals, and outstanding decisions. Draft contractual notices and formal correspondence, track client and consultant instructions, and flag work requiring formal change authorization. Prepare and substantiate variation proposals for changes in scope, quantities, design, or work sequence, coordinating with relevant departments for contractual basis, valuation, and schedule impact. Prepare time extension and additional cost submissions, working with Planning to establish cause, effect, critical impact, and compile contemporaneous records. Represent the contractor in contractual and commercial meetings, presenting submissions, responding to comments, supporting negotiations, and recording actions. Review the contractual basis for payment applications, deductions, retention, and disputed amounts, coordinating with Quantity Surveying and Finance. Review subcontract terms and change requests for alignment with main-contract obligations, escalating any unpassable exposure. Support contractual closeout by reconciling outstanding variations and claims, tracking handover, defects obligations, retention release, and guarantee expiry. a38e26b6aba50a15.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن مشغل مضخة مياه للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان الجاهزية التشغيلية لمضخات مياه إطفاء الحرائق وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية اللازمة للحفاظ على كفاءتها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد مضخة مياه إطفاء الحرائق بشكل دوري وفقاً للجداول الزمنية المحددة. التحقق من جاهزية المضخة وتوافر المياه الكافي، وفتح صمامات مداخل ومخارج المياه. ربط خراطيم مياه الإطفاء بمخرج المضخة بطريقة صحيحة وآمنة. تشغيل المضخة عند نشوب أي حريق أو وفقاً لخطط العمل المتفق عليها، ومراقبة أدائها. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية لمضخة مياه إطفاء الحريق لضمان عملها بكفاءة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال تشغيل وصيانة المضخات، ويفضل أن تكون في مضخات إطفاء الحرائق. القدرة على تفقد المعدات وتحديد الأعطال المحتملة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة المتعلقة بتشغيل وصيانة المضخات. بيئة العمل يعمل مشغل مضخة المياه في المدينة المنورة ضمن فريق متخصص، ويكون مسؤولاً عن ضمان الجاهزية الدائمة لمعدات إطفاء الحرائق. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بجدول زمني محدد للمهام الدورية والاستعداد للتدخل السريع عند الحاجة. نوع التوظيف هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية التوظيف.

a3529930d9a34993.description: I. Role Title ERM/Operational Risk Specialist II. Role Purpose To implement and continuously operate CLIENT's Operational Risk Management Framework by facilitating RCSAs, maintaining the enterprise Risk Register, challenging risk assessments, monitoring KRIs, coordinating risk reporting, and embedding proactive risk management across all Business Units. III. Key Responsibilities a. Operational Risk Lifecycle  Execute and continuously operate CLIENT's Operational Risk Procedures across all Business Units.  Facilitate the end-to-end operational risk lifecycle from risk identification through monitoring, reporting, and periodic reassessment.  Ensure operational risks remain aligned with CLIENT's Risk Appetite and Risk Management Framework. b. Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSA)  Plan, facilitate, and document RCSA workshops with Business Units.  Challenge inherent and residual risk assessments using approved methodologies.  Assess control design and operating effectiveness.  Ensure consistent application of CLIENT's likelihood and impact scoring methodology.  Produce finalized RCSA outputs and obtain Business Unit sign-off. c. Enterprise Risk Register  Maintain the enterprise Risk Register.  Ensure risks are accurately documented, categorized, scored, linked to controls, action plans, KRIs, and Business Process Owners.  Monitor changes in residual risk and recommend reassessment where required.  Track risk treatment actions until closure. d. Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)  Develop KRIs for material operational risks.  Define thresholds and escalation triggers.  Monitor KRI performance and identify deteriorating risk trends.  Recommend new KRIs or threshold revisions where appropriate.  Produce periodic KRI reporting. e. Risk Monitoring & Reporting  Monitor emerging operational risks across the organization.  Prepare risk reports for Executive Management, ExCom, GARC and the Board.  Escalate significant risks and appetite breaches in accordance with approved governance requirements.  Track recurring issues and thematic risk trends. f. Risk Events & Lessons Learned  Coordinate operational risk event reporting.  Investigate significant operational incidents alongside Business Units.  Perform root cause analysis.  Ensure lessons learned are incorporated into RCSA and control improvements. g. Risk Advisory  Support Business Units in identifying practical risk treatments.  Provide independent challenge while maintaining a collaborative partnership with the First Line.  Advise on operational risk implications of new initiatives, organizational changes, outsourcing arrangements and major projects. h. Continuous Improvement  Recommend enhancements to operational risk methodologies, templates and reporting.  Support development of risk culture through awareness sessions and coaching.  Contribute to periodic reviews of the Operational Risk Procedures. IV. Experience  5–8 years' experience in Operational Risk, Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Controls, Internal Audit or Governance.  Experience facilitating RCSA workshops.  Experience maintaining enterprise Risk Registers.  Experience designing and monitoring KRIs.  Experience preparing Board and Committee risk reporting.  Experience applying ISO 31000 or COSO ERM frameworks.  Financial services, sovereign funds, private equity or development finance experience preferred. V. Technical Skills  Enterprise Risk Management  Operational Risk Management  Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSA)  Risk Registers  Risk & Control Matrices (RCM)  Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)  Root Cause Analysis  Control Effectiveness Assessment  Risk Reporting  Microsoft Excel and Power BI (preferred) VI. Behavioral Competencies  Strong analytical judgement  Structured facilitation skills  Ability to challenge constructively  Excellent stakeholder management  Strong report writing  High attention to detail  Ability to simplify complex risk issues  Independent thinking  Organized and execution-oriented

You will be the driving force behind the design, optimization, and safe operation of complex cryogenic air separation processes, ensuring peak production and stringent safety compliance in high-purity oxygen environments. The work location would be in Tanajib /Khursaniyah. Key Responsibilities: Asset Specification & Sizing: Lead the specification and sizing of critical ASU assets, including high-pressure air compressors, air adsorption and dehydration systems, turboexpanders, Brazed Aluminum Heat Exchangers (BAHX), and cryogenic distillation columns. Storage & Vaporization Management: Oversee liquid oxygen and nitrogen storage and vaporization systems to guarantee reliable peak production and backup supply. Commissioning & Start-Up: Provide hands-on leadership during cryogenic ASU commissioning, start-ups, and performance guarantee testing. Troubleshooting & Optimization: Act as the ultimate technical authority for troubleshooting complex operational issues and optimizing Molecular Sieve Adsorption Systems (pre-purification units) for maximum moisture removal and regeneration cycle efficiency. Advanced Process Simulation: Utilize advanced proficiency in Aspen HYSYS or PRO/II, specifically calibrating process simulations for cryogenic air separation cycles and validating models against real-world plant data. Safety & Compliance: Apply deep practical knowledge of Compressed Gases and Cryogenic Fluids Codes. Champion safety standards regarding oxygen compatibility and fire hazard management within high-purity oxygen environments. Bachelors Degree in Engineering 10+ years of strictly hands-on, specialized experience in Air Separation Units (ASU) and Cryogenics. Proven track record in cryogenic ASU commissioning, start-up, and performance testing. Mastery of process simulation software (Aspen HYSYS, PRO/II) with a focus on cryogenic calibration. Deep understanding of the mechanical and thermodynamic principles behind turboexpanders, BAHX, and distillation columns. Uncompromising commitment to process safety, with expert knowledge of global codes and standards for handling compressed gases and cryogenic fluids. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and cross-functional leadership skills.

a396161b4c621878.description: Who Are We❓ We Are Servme! A powerhouse guest experience and CRM platform built for modern hospitality. Purpose-built from the front to the back of the house, Servme seamlessly integrates with telephone systems, point of sale, hotel PMS, payments, and major social platforms like Facebook, Google, and Instagram. We're not just another booking tool — we're the operational brain behind smarter restaurants, cafes, and hotels. And yes, we're growing fast. With a relentless focus on streamlining hospitality, Servme is becoming the go-to guest experience platform in the region and beyond. Ready to serve smarter? That's Servme. The Job in a Nutshell💡 This SMB Account Manager owns one of Servme's most valuable relationships. It is a dedicated, hands-on role responsible for retaining, deepening, and growing flagship hotel or enterprise accounts. The role goes deep on a key accounts, building intimate knowledge of the client's operations, stakeholders, and goals to maximize value on both sides. and onboard accounts to keep product usability, adoption, and satisfaction high Develop an intimate understanding of each account's organizational structure, decision-making process, and strategic account records and activity in the CRM Provide regular updates to leadership on account status, growth pipeline, and renewal timing Own accurate revenue forecasting for assigned accounts What Are We Looking For❓ 4+ years of experience in key/strategic account management, enterprise customer success, or client- facing commercial roles, ideally within SaaS or hospitality tech. Proven experience managing and growing large, complex, multi-site accounts (hotel groups, F&B chains, or similar). Strong track record of expansion revenue generation: upsell, cross-sell, and multi-site rollout. Comfortable operating as a dedicated, embedded partner to a small number of high-value clients, rather than managing a broad book of business. Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and executive communication skills. Data-driven approach to tracking account health and growth metrics. a31ef8a60e446022.description: Overview: Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an experienced Senior Manager - Asset Management to support the Head of Asset Management in shaping and delivering a citywide asset management framework.
